_comment: Marks src/tui as ESM, and nothing else.
Ink's layout engine (yoga-layout) is ESM-only and uses top-level await,
which cannot be transpiled to CommonJS. This package is CommonJS for Next,
so without this marker tsx tries to down-level yoga-layout and the UI fails
to start with 'Top-level await is currently not supported with the cjs output
format'. Scoping the marker to this directory keeps the web app CommonJS.
Next never reads it: it only scans src/pages and src/app for routes.
